messages:
sara_cs: Heads-up — drafted a concise customer-facing 'Onboard Primer' for accounts hitting slow first-call latency. Focus is practical caching/batching/stream tips + renewal-health checkpoints. Link: https://redwood.example/runbooks/onboard-primer (preview)
sara_cs: Key sections: 1) Quick prefill checklist 2) Lightweight cache TTL suggestions 3) Client-side batching patterns 4) Streaming fallback for degraded throughput 5) Renewal signal capture & feedback loop
petes_se: skimmed it. can we add a short code snippet for client-side batching? customers keep asking for a starter example.
sara_cs: good call. i added a 3-line JS example under 'Client batching — starter' (very small):
petes_se: nice. can you paste the snippet here so CS can copy into emails?
sara_cs: ```js
// simple client-side batcher (pseudo)
let q = []
setInterval(() => { if (q.length) sendBatch(q.splice(0)) }, 50)
function enqueue(r) { q.push(r) }
```
ana_pm: quick question — for renewal-risk accounts should we recommend prefilling historical prompts or only conservative caching? want to avoid hallucination regressions.
sara_cs: recommend controlled prefill: only replay verified prompts from the last 30 days and mark them as "historic_context" in metadata so we can track quality drift. also add a manual QA checkpoint before wide prefill.
jess_ops: added a telemetry snippet to the runbook for capture. paste below is the event contract we use to track warmup success/failure:
jess_ops: ```json
{"event":"onboard_warmup","tenant_id":"<id>","prefill_success":true,"avg_latency_ms":120,"batch_size":8}
```
petes_se: nice. what's the suggested threshold for 'avg_latency_ms' to mark a green warmup?
sara_cs: green if <150ms for 95th pct; amber 150-300, red >300. we call for canary warm pool expansion if amber persists >10m.
ana_pm: for renewal check-ins, can we add a short template question set to capture "did onboarding meet SLA" + NPS-style quick feedback?
sara_cs: added a 3-question template at the end: 1) Did latency meet expectations? 2) Any quality regressions observed? 3) Would you recommend Redwood to a colleague? (1–10) — stores answers in feedback channel and links to account timeline.
eng-bot: deploy:runbook/onboard-primer published by sara_cs @ 2026-03-20T15:12:34Z :white_check_mark:
petes_se: thank you — i'll sync with Solutions to embed the snippet into the starter SDK example and share with onboarding leads.
sara_cs: thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: if you approve or drop quick edits inline. planning to send customer-ready link on Friday.
